reference.stack: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui + Rizum Glass

states.name: default
states.notes: Confirm and dismiss share the same neutral shell; the confirm icon alone uses accent teal.

states.name: confirmed
states.notes: Text and icon settle without changing button dimensions.

motion.reducedMotion: Use a 120ms opacity transition with no scale change.

materialFallbacks.winuiStrategy: Use a neutral translucent panel over a window-level Mica backdrop; use Desktop Acrylic only for transient overlays.
materialFallbacks.fallback: Use RizumBrushGlassPanel with the same border, spacing, typography, and hierarchy when transparency is disabled.
materialFallbacks.acceptedDifference: Per-element background refraction may be flatter than the approved web reference.
